_note: Plain-English labels for SPHEREx FLAGS bits, written from the official MSKD descriptions. The official names stay visible in the website too. 'info': true marks flags that are information, not a problem.

TRANSIENT.label: Brief glitch during readout (e.g. a cosmic-ray hit)

SUR_ERROR.label: Error while the spacecraft processed this pixel

DICHROIC.label: Low sensitivity here because of the telescope's colour-splitting mirror

PERSIST.label: Afterglow from a bright source seen earlier

OUTLIER.label: Value looks unusual compared with its neighbours

CROSSTALK.label: Echo of a bright pixel elsewhere on the detector

SOURCE.label: A known star or galaxy is here (information only)

GHOST.label: Reflection of a bright star in this image

GHOST_FPA.label: Reflection of a bright star on another detector

GHOST_EXT.label: Glare from a bright star outside the image

BLOOM.label: Charge bleeding from a saturated star
